subject: lk-imp
title: LK.IMP.------LANG.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 114 (T(AF)M-18). LK-IMP (linkage implications) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; LANG-DY (language dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: EXPN, INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", PRI-INFO (principle information) and AF-CON (affinity convergence). From EXPN: AFTF (affinity transfer). From AFTF: a second LANG-DY (language dynamics). From PRI-INFO: MT-INTR (multiple interpretation). From MT-INTR: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) and COS-D (cosmic dictates). From COS-D: SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From SOC-RT-DY: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications).
